## HISTORY AND PHYSICAL
Date: 05/20/2026
## CC
Abdominal pain, nausea, unable to keep food down x 3 days
## HPI
72 y/o F with pancreatic adenocarcinoma (dx 01/2026) with liver metastases, declined further chemotherapy after 2 cycles (03/2026) due to toxicity. Homeless since 2024, previously staying in friend's garage, asked to leave 04/2026, now sleeping at bus terminal. Presents with worsening epigastric pain radiating to back (8/10) and nausea/emesis, poor PO intake. No hematemesis, no melena.

- Pancreatic adenocarcinoma, stage IV
- Hypothyroidism
- Osteoarthritis knees

- Oxycodone 5 mg q6h PRN (ran out 1 wk ago)
